criteria_verification.criterion_text: Test: Subscriber drops a message with `envelope.source_id="malicious"` —
criteria_verification.evidence: Added TestSubscriberDropsMaliciousSourceId.test_malicious_source_id_drops_message_and_logs_warn — instantiates the real ForgeNotificationsSubscriber with mocked NATS client / writer / SessionManager, builds a real MessageEnvelope with source_id='malicious' wrapping a real StageCompletePayload, patches forge_notifications.logger.warning to capture structlog calls, awaits subscriber._handle_message(msg), asserts session_manager.enqueue_notification not called, writer.append_build_queue_event not called, and the canonical WARN event 'forge_notification_dropped_unknown_source' was emitted carrying source_id='malicious'.
